findings.evidence: Phrase: "A chip maker's chief resigned after a spy scandal erased a trillion dollars." No name used, but the detail combination (sole chief of a chip maker, resignation over an alleged-spy scandal, ~$1 trillion loss, same-day rival Gemini launch) uniquely identifies Jensen Huang/Nvidia per sources, matching the rubric's banned pattern of unmistakable description (e.g. 'the richest man's rocket company CEO').
findings.suggestion: Curate stage should genericize the phrase so it no longer uniquely resolves to one identifiable person: drop the specific dollar figure and/or the 'spy' framing, e.g. 'A chip maker's leadership shake-up rattled investors.'
